en.headline: Motorist stops missing six-year-old boy outside Yuen Long Plaza
en.dek: Police said a passer-by reported the child wandering near Castle Peak Road on Saturday afternoon; he was unhurt and returned to his mother.
body: Police said that at about 4.44pm on Saturday a member of the public reported seeing a six-year-old boy walking alone on the pavement outside Yuen Long Plaza, on Castle Peak Road – Yuen Long.

The caller told officers he was concerned the child might step into the road and took him to a safe place before ringing the police. Officers later established that the boy’s family had already reported him missing.
The child was not injured. Police said he was handed back to his 45-year-old mother. No further police action was announced.

zh.headline: 元朗廣場外發現報失六歲男童 途人報案助團聚
zh.dek: 警方指周六下午有途人在青山公路元朗段近元朗廣場發現男童獨自徘徊，事主沒有受傷，其後交還45歲母親照顧。
body: 警方表示，周六下午約4時44分接獲途人報案，指在青山公路元朗段、元朗廣場對開行人路見到一名六歲男童獨自徘徊，擔心他會走出馬路，於是先將他帶到安全位置再報警。
警員到場調查後，發現男童較早前已被家人報失。男童沒有受傷。
事後男童交還其45歲母親照顧。警方未有公布進一步行動。
